s.note: the plate left out on Christmas Eve
s.how: Brown 150g butter and cool. Beat with 200g brown sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour, half a tsp bicarb and 200g choc chips. Rest overnight. Bake 16 cookies at 180C for 11 minutes. Serve with 1L cold milk.

s.note: the elves' workshop at the North Pole
s.how: Stack 3 bocconcini on a skewer, about 300g in total, and top with half a cherry tomato as a hat. Press in cracked peppercorns for eyes and tie a basil leaf as a scarf. Drizzle with olive oil. Makes about 8.

m.note: Scott burns his, so this one's for him
m.how: Brine a 1.5kg turkey breast overnight. Roll with 60g butter mixed with chopped sage and roast at 170C until 70C inside, then rest 20 minutes. Bake a packet of stuffing alongside and roast 1kg potatoes. Make gravy with 300ml stock.

w.note: the elves' workshop at the North Pole
w.how: Melt 125g butter, 100g brown sugar and 100g golden syrup. Stir in 300g flour, 2 tsp ginger, 1 tsp cinnamon and half a tsp bicarb. Chill an hour, roll, cut into elves and trees and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Ice with 200g icing sugar in red and green.

d.note: not too hot, not too cold
d.how: Whisk 4 tbsp cocoa, 4 tbsp sugar and a pinch of salt with a splash of milk into a paste. Add 900ml milk, 100ml cream, a pinch of cinnamon and a drop of vanilla. Warm to drinking temperature without boiling and pour.
